title: Counterfactuals and uncertainty-based explainable paradigm for the automated detection and segmentation of renal cysts in contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography: A multi-center study

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Counterfactuals and uncertainty-based explainable paradigm for the automated detection and segmentation of renal cysts in contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography: A multi-center study》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography (CT) scans frequently detect renal cysts, some of which may be malignant.

evidence.text: Contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography (CT) scans frequently detect renal cysts, some of which may be malignant.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Counterfactuals and uncertainty-based explainable paradigm for the automated detection and segmentation of renal cysts in contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography: A multi-center study》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Early and precise localization improves patient management and enables quantitative image analysis.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We developed an interpretable 3D renal cyst segmentation framework and validated it on 1486 cysts from 568 patients across three centers and an open-source dataset.

evidence.text: Early and precise localization improves patient management and enables quantitative image analysis.
We developed an interpretable 3D renal cyst segmentation framework and validated it on 1486 cysts from 568 patients across three centers and an open-source dataset.

sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】The framework achieved a DSC of 0.82 on two external test sets, with sensitivities of 0.95 and 0.97, respectively.

evidence.text: The framework achieved a DSC of 0.82 on two external test sets, with sensitivities of 0.95 and 0.97, respectively.
